project.place_time: Seventh-century Goguryeo-Sui frontier, summer 612 AD, the Liaodong plain.
project.era_lock: Strictly seventh-century East Asian setting only - Goguryeo soldiers in lamellar armor and iron helmets with feather plumes, Sui soldiers in red-laced iron armor, timber and rammed-earth fortress walls, ox-carts and felt tents - no European medieval armor, no modern objects, no vehicles, no modern clothing.
project.audio_effects: wind, marching feet, iron armor, flags snapping, distant war drums

casting.general: Goguryeo general in his fifties, lean weathered face, grey-streaked topknot, short beard, dark lamellar armor with a red sash, calm narrowed eyes.
casting.scout: young Goguryeo scout, early twenties, sunburnt face, leather cap, light quilted tunic, a coil of rope over one shoulder.

scenes.narration: 여기에 나레이션 원문을 그대로 적는다(프롬프트에는 안 들어가고 파일 머리말에만 남는다).
scenes.opening: the camera skims low and fast over a wide grey river plain while wind-driven dust streaks the glass; a long column of Sui infantry fills the far bank, small and dark, held OFF-CENTER in the right third of the frame.
development: Without a cut the camera climbs backwards and upward into an aerial wide, the column unrolling endlessly toward the horizon, banners snapping in the wind, ox-carts crawling between the ranks.
The climb continues until the whole plain is a moving carpet of men; a lone Goguryeo watchtower stands tiny on a ridge at the left edge, seen from behind its sentry.
scenes.light: the low sun sits BEHIND the far ridge, just outside frame - thin volumetric shafts push through the dust toward the camera, a hard rim of light traces helmets and banner silk, faces stay half in shadow, a soft flare kisses one corner. Never frontal, never flat.
scenes.camera: one continuous unbroken move - a low fast skim across the plain, lifting and climbing backwards into an extreme wide aerial - never a hard cut, never static.
lens_hits: a torn strip of red silk slapping flat across the lens and dragging off
a burst of grit peppering the glass

scenes.opening: a close low-angle view of iron-shod boots stepping through shallow river water, spray flying toward the lens.

shots.text: boots splash through the shallows in a tight column, seen from behind and below, water beads sliding down the glass.
a Goguryeo general in profile on the bank, framed OFF-CENTER on the left third, watching the crossing from behind a foreground spear shaft.
an overhead aerial of the ford, the column a dark thread across brown water, banners snapping.

scenes.light: a smoky amber late-afternoon sun sits BEHIND the far bank, rim-lighting the spray and the spear tips while faces stay in soft shadow.
scenes.camera: three distinct angles joined by hard cuts - low tracking, side profile, high aerial.
lens_hits: river spray beading on the glass
a flying splinter of wet wood crossing the frame
a gust of dust smearing the lens
